policy: Retain existing companion selection/unlock IDs; do not add duplicate companion inventory
Six launch decor IDs are free built-in Home furnishings; no item consumption, new currencies or unlock economy

Legacy homestead.display weapon/scroll/trophy/none remains preserved; home.wall_display=null means legacy display binding, scroll maps home_plans and trophy maps home_trophy at migration; weapon remains existing equipped-item icon
Absent home_layout migrates to defaults, preserves companion mode follow and all older fields
Unknown IDs/slot mismatches discard only bad placement; never delete inventory or valid companion ownership
Grounded pet saved to incompatible wall slot relocates to floor if cushion exists, otherwise follow
Unavailable/unaccepted perch art disables perch interaction and retains follow; never idle-as-perch fallback
Removing occupied perch moves pet to follow, preserves equipped_id, and persists layout atomically
Save only valid complete layout on Apply, never drag intermediates; Cancel/Back discards draft
Save semantic validation and current save transaction/checksum discipline must be preserved
Reload restores selection, mode, slot and decor layout; transient move/reaction timer is not saved
Current profile_store sanitizer strips new fields; later integration MUST explicitly extend it. This package does not change runtime code.
